title: Black Box can attribute another profile's process to its recorder
recommendation: Bind recorder OS observations to an explicitly handed-off PID and creation time or a freshly verified exact-profile runtime record. Preserve one process generation across all views and exports; show UNKNOWN when identity is missing, stale or ambiguous. Keep the recorder read-only.
disposition: SIDE-04 rejects ambiguity among independent matching cores instead of choosing by RSS; 64 affected regressions passed. Exact automatic single-core/profile ownership remains advisory; explicit Live AI Review binds PID and creation time.
